Name: 300 Swedish Birds
MetaDescription: The checklist for birders in Sweden. Tick off species, log where and when you saw them, identify birds by their song and compete with friends. Free, in your browser.
Eyebrow: The checklist for birders in Sweden
Headline: Every bird you see in Sweden, in one list.
Lede: Tick off species as you see them, note where and when, and watch your year list grow. Free, on your phone and your computer.
MockLabel: Example of the app: a year list with 87 of 300 species, a bird identified by its song and a new species added.
FeaturesLede: Built by birders for birders in Sweden: quick to use in the field, and with all the details when you get home.

Faq.a: No. 300 Swedish Birds is free to use. You can support the project with a donation if you like.
The ready-made list has the 300 most common birds in Sweden. Your own lists can include any of over 2,000 species in the catalogue.

Faq.q: I used the 300 Svenska Fåglar app. Can I keep my sightings?
Faq.a: Yes. Sign in, open Account and import your sightings with the app's email and password.

Faq.q: Do I need to install an app?
Faq.a: No. 300 Swedish Birds runs in the browser on your phone, tablet and computer.

Faq.q: Can I get my data out?
Faq.a: Yes. Download a list as a spreadsheet (CSV) or all your data at once, whenever you like.

Faq.q: How reliable is the sound identification?
Faq.a: It is a suggestion, not a certain identification. It works best with a clear recording of a singing bird, close by.

CtaText: Free, and ready in a minute. The next bird you see could be the first one on it.
